env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 5 8 7 8 9$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/spreadaddr

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type S struct {
	A int
	B int
}

func id(p *S) *S {
	return p
}

func pair(p *S, n int) int {
	return p.A + p.B + n
}

func main() {
	a := S{A: 1, B: 2}
	q := id(&S{B: 5, ..a})
	r := pair(&S{B: 6, ..a}, 1)
	s := (&S{B: 7, ..a})
	t := &(S{B: 8, ..a})
	u := id((&S{B: 9, ..a}))
	fmt.Println(q.A, q.B, r, s.B, t.B, u.B)
}
